TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.label: Frost Sigil
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.description: A passive tattoo granting cold resistance and a chance to slow melee attackers on hit.
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.modifierSummary: Tier 1: +5 cold resistance, 15% chance to slow an attacker on hit. Tier 2: +10 cold resistance, 30% slow chance, plus a 10% chance to freeze the attacker.
